name: KOReader client (Kaleido colour PNG)
description: Composition PNG fitted to the e-reader's screen and quantised to the E Ink Kaleido 3 gamut: a 24-bit RGB PNG with every channel dithered to 16 levels (4096 colours), which is what a colour filter over 16-grey glass can show. For colour e-readers running KOReader with the Tesserae plugin (Kobo Libra Colour, Clara Colour); the plugin decodes the PNG with the reader's own image stack and blits it in colour, no packed buffer. A device lands here by pairing with gamut kaleido3; greyscale readers stay on the packed grey renderers. Per-device picture quality (dither / contrast) lives on the device card.

settings.name: contrast
settings.label: Pre-dither contrast
settings.help: Push midtones toward black or white before the dither pass. 1.0 leaves the image alone; > 1.0 deepens contrast (good for photos with grey skies); < 1.0 softens (good for text-heavy dashboards).
